name: 1-summary
h1: The short version of a long page
p: Open Scout in Safari and it sums up the article or recipe you're reading.

name: 2-ask
p: Scout answers from the page you're on, like whether a price is fair.

name: 3-scout-mode
p: Scout mode fills out forms for you and asks before it buys anything.

name: 4-coupons
p: At checkout, Scout tries codes in your cart and keeps the one that saves the most.

name: 5-settings
p: There's no Scout account, and no ads or tracking. Scout asks before it sends anything to your AI provider.
